en: The image shows an old, sepia-toned postcard depicting a large, three-story Baroque-style building with a central triangular pediment and symmetrically arranged windows. The foreground features a paved square with stone posts connected by chains and a large tree in the center. The sky is partially cloudy, and the photo has a historic, early 20th-century aesthetic. There is some small white text on the bottom left of the image.
